theme: An open day with a few overdue threads to close.
greeting: A completely clear calendar today, Dan. The only real pulls are a handful of overdue to-dos and one light call on tomorrow's horizon.

needsAttention.title: Brunswick call at 11
needsAttention.detail: Erika Maass at Brunswick Group has you on a 30-minute Teams call tomorrow late morning. Worth arriving with a few thoughts on what you want out of it.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: Your p1 task to book a refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week is about two weeks past due. Holiday inventory there thins fast, so a refundable hold now costs nothing and closes the risk.

needsAttention.title: Three term-life quotes for Mike
needsAttention.detail: The task to gather three term-life quotes is a few days overdue. You own the shopping — quotes, term length, coverage — and Mike handles the application.

flagged.title: AMEX balance alert
flagged.detail: An automated myFICO alert flagged a higher reported balance on your American Express card. Informational — nothing to action.

inbox.noise: About a dozen newsletters and promos — Bloomberg, Press Herald, SoFi, Dermstore, a few Substacks — plus three LinkedIn connection invites.
inbox.clear: No email is waiting on your reply this morning.

resolved.title: Maine Visionaries — you're in
resolved.detail: You told Ellen Richstone and Josh Broder you'd help recruit directors for NACD New England's Maine Visionaries program; both confirmed back.

recipe.title: Ras el Hanout Chicken and Spelt
recipe.why: A warming, spice-forward one-pot dish for the turn into autumn, when hearty grains and roast chicken start to feel right again.

acts.line: Nothing on the calendar this morning.
The afternoon is open too — no meetings all day.
Tomorrow starts light: a single call late morning.
